CommunityApplications.Profile:
**Reelarr** is an *arr for live concert recordings: it identifies, tags and files tapes, soundboards and Live Music Archive downloads into a clean library, monitors artists for new uploads, and holds anything uncertain for review. Open source under GPL-3.0.
Questions, bugs and feature requests: [GitHub issues](https://github.com/elendil2112/reelarr/issues).
